name: list_device_inventory
summary: Expose a bounded read-only inventory of registered Kinex devices so a model can discover capabilities without scanning the workspace.

generality.rationale: Every Kinex task must select registered devices, and the output is independent of task, object class, embodiment, simulator, and perception model.
assumptions: Registered devices have readable Kinex profiles under the active workspace.
limitations: Activation intent does not prove that a driver is loaded, healthy, or calibrated.

level.rationale: The tool performs one bounded read-only enumeration and profile normalization operation with no device interaction.

composition.strategy: Enumerate immediate device profile directories and normalize a fixed subset of profile metadata.

provenance.failure_gap: Qwen had no model-callable device inventory, attempted an unbounded recursive filesystem scan, and entered a runaway tool-call stream.
evidence: iter_003 second model response produced more than 21000 characters of recursive ls arguments before any detector discovery
